summary: The Wall Street Journal reported that VideoAmp laid off roughly 20% of its staff, about 50 to 60 employees, as CEO Tony Fagan said the company is investing in agentic software development and becoming an AI-powered media performance platform.
evidenceQuote: For VideoAmp, that means continuing to invest in agentic software development and becoming an AI-powered media performance platform, aligning our organization, resources, and operating model to support that direction.
notes: The layoff count is recorded as 55 to represent the reported 50-to-60 employee range. This is classified as AI-adjacent restructuring because the company tied the restructuring to AI strategy and agentic software investment, not because the reporting proves every eliminated role was directly replaced by AI.

sources.name: The Wall Street Journal
sources.quote: VideoAmp laid off approximately 20% of its staff this week as the ad measurement platform responds to the rise of AI, a spokeswoman confirmed to the Wall Street Journal Leadership Institute.

sources.name: Main Street Independent
sources.quote: Fagan said VideoAmp would continue investing in agentic software development and become an AI-powered media performance platform.
